name: Rename names that hide lantern namespaces
body: Dean (2026-11-14): building the editor prints 285 NOX0920 warnings: parameters, locals and fields named editor, world, renderer, gpu and platform hide the namespaces lantern:::editor, lantern:::world, lantern:::renderer, lantern:::gpu and lantern:::platform. Rename each to a name that says what it holds (editorInstance, worldFile, renderWorld, collisionWorld, gpuRenderer, sdlRenderer and so on), so the build is quiet and a path like editor:::X can never resolve to the wrong thing. No behaviour change. Stacked on PR #67 (it needs that build fix).
acceptance_criteria: nox build of the editor and the engine prints no NOX0920 warnings.
The engine tests pass as before (189).
